sourceNote: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as Exophase publishes it, agreeing with PSNProfiles. PSN progress targets are from PSNProfiles. Guides are our own words from the official descriptions, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks when the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is no shortcut. Work through the roadmap in order: finish the story, clear the stranger strands, then the activities and the collectibles. The tracker shows exactly what is left.
steps: Finish the story (Stage 1)
Clear stranger strands and side content (Stage 2)
Finish activities and challenges (Stage 3)
Clean up collectibles and 100% completion (Stage 4)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so it comes to you — just play the opening and the trophy pops at the end of the mission.
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing
The trophy pops when the mission ends

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The chapter ends when the story moves on — you cannot miss it by playing the story. Follow the mission markers; side content can wait for later stages.
steps: Play through Chapter 1's missions in order
The trophy pops at the chapter's final cutscene

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like every chapter trophy, it pops when the chapter ends — play the story through and it comes to you.
steps: Play through Chapter 2's missions in order
The trophy pops at the chapter's final cutscene

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The chapter trophy pops at the end of the chapter — keep playing the story and it is yours.
steps: Play through Chapter 3's missions in order
The trophy pops at the chapter's final cutscene

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter. The trophy pops at the chapter's end, right before the finale.
steps: Play through Chapter 4's missions in order
The trophy pops at the chapter's final cutscene

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It unlocks after Chapter 4. Before you start it, clear the missables on the Missables page — some of them need a partner or a story moment that ends here.
steps: Clear the missable trophies first (see Missables)
Play the final mission to the end

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so it comes up as you play — you cannot miss it. The name is the hint: a morning run that sets up the day's work.
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run appears
Complete the mission

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story heist — play the story through and it unlocks in order. Heists are the big set pieces: follow the plan the mission gives you.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears
Complete the heist

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission — it appears as you play through the chapters, and the trophy pops when it ends.
steps: Play the story until Child's Play appears
Complete the mission

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission in the chapter flow — play until it appears, then finish it.
steps: Play the story until Headliners appears
Complete the mission

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport — it comes up in the chapter flow, and the trophy pops when the takedown is done.
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears
Complete the mission

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission — play the chapters until it appears, then finish the operation.
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears
Complete the mission

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long one: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the miscellaneous counts all feed into it. Use the in-game stats page to see what is missing, then work the checklist here — this trophy pops with the last item, just before the platinum.
steps: Finish the story and stranger strands
Complete the activities and collectibles
Check the in-game stats for the last missing items

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, airtime and the rest. Stunts count anywhere in Leonida, so they pile up naturally while you drive. To farm them, use a fast bike on the highway ramps and the Vice City jumps: jump, land clean, repeat.
steps: Stunts count in normal driving — they add up as you play
To farm: a fast bike, highway ramps, jump and land clean
PSN tracks the count: 250

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: races, shooting range, drone races, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, and the rest. You do not need to win or finish — just try each one. Open the activities list in the pause menu and tick them off one by one.
steps: Open the activities list in the pause menu
Try each activity type once — no win needed
PSN tracks the count: 9

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges. You need a gold medal in every one. Learn each range's pattern first with a bronze run, then push for gold: steady aim beats fast fire, and the timer is generous if you do not miss. The range is the cheapest place to practice — ammo is free there.
steps: Learn each challenge with a bronze run first
Push for gold: steady aim, do not miss
Gold in all 42 challenges

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course — learn the gates on a practice run, then race for the win. Drones handle the same everywhere, so the skill transfers; the hard part is memorizing each course's tight gates.
steps: Practice each course to learn the gates
Win the race at that location
Repeat at all 14 locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events. Mix street races, off-road and water races; the map marks them. Winning is easier with a tuned car for the race's class, and you can retry any race.
steps: Find races on the map — street, off-road, water
Win with a tuned car for the race's class
20 different races, each counts once

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal shows up at the fishing spots — challenge him and out-fish him. Fishing is a timing mini-game: wait for the bite, then reel steadily without snapping the line. Flagged missable: the description gives Cal's challenge no second chance, so take it the first time he offers it instead of walking away.
steps: Find Cal at a fishing spot
Accept the fishing challenge the first time he offers it
Reel steadily — do not snap the line

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, any machine, any game. The arcades are marked on the map — walk up, play, and finish a run. You do not need a high score; completing the game is enough.
steps: Find an arcade on the map
Play any machine and finish a run

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand, then his final mission. Stranger strands appear as markers on the map as you explore — start Andy's early so his missions unlock in order. The final mission pops the trophy.
steps: Find Andy's stranger marker on the map
Play his missions in order
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand, then his final mission. Start his strand when the marker appears, play the missions in order, and the trophy pops at the end of the final one.
steps: Find Kenton's stranger marker on the map
Play his missions in order
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand, then his final mission. The strand's missions unlock in order — play them as they appear and the final mission pops the trophy.
steps: Find Billy's stranger marker on the map
Play his missions in order
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands. Strangers appear across Leonida as you explore — each strand is a short chain of missions. There are more than 8 strangers, so you can skip one whose missions you dislike. The trophy pops on the eighth completed strand.
steps: Explore Leonida to find stranger markers
Play each strand's missions in order
Complete 8 strands

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand, then his final mission. Play the strand's missions in order as they unlock; the final mission pops the trophy.
steps: Find Randy's stranger marker on the map
Play his missions in order
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand, then his final mission. The strand's missions unlock in order — play them as they appear and the trophy pops at the end.
steps: Find Tyrone's stranger marker on the map
Play his missions in order
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The spots are marked once you find one — they sit at viewpoints and quiet corners. Meditation is quick; the work is finding all 18, so sweep the map region by region.
steps: Find a meditation spot — viewpoints and quiet corners
Meditate there; it counts at once
Sweep region by region until all 18 are done

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a one-time task — the animal is unique, so there is no second one if the hunt goes wrong. Track the animal patiently and take a clean shot. Take the hunt when Bret offers it; the description gives no second chance.
steps: Find Bret and accept the hunt
Track the unique animal patiently
Take a clean shot — there is only one

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, houses and odd corners. A set is complete when you hold every card in it. Check cards off here as you find them; you need 3 full sets, not every card in the game.
steps: Search shops, houses and odd corners for cards
A set is complete when you hold every card in it
Complete 3 full sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-world photo and tagging activity — open it at marked spots and tag the location. 100 sounds like a lot, but the spots are everywhere in the cities; sweep district by district and the count climbs fast.
steps: Open WAiNK It at a marked spot and tag the location
Sweep district by district
100 locations total

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the small tasks the game tracks — stunts, driving feats, combat feats and more. They complete as you play; check the challenges list to see which are close, then mop up the easy ones to reach 50.
steps: Challenges complete as you play
Check the challenges list for the ones close to done
Mop up the easy ones to reach 50

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. You need your partner in the car with you — this only works while the story still has you partnered up, so do it during the story, not after. Get 4 stars, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear.
steps: Do this during the story, with your partner beside you
Reach a 4-star wanted level
Break line of sight and hide until the stars clear

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Plan a route through three close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving — the wanted level must stay live the whole time. Like Hot Together, this needs your partner, so do it during the story.
steps: Do this during the story, with your partner beside you
Plan a route through three close shops
Rob all three back-to-back, wanted level live the whole time

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or ride anything new and it counts. Vehicles you have never driven count once. The easiest way: sweep car parks, dealerships and the docks, hopping into anything unfamiliar.
steps: Drive or ride anything you have never driven
Sweep car parks, dealerships and docks
100 different vehicles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus slows time — trigger it in a group of enemies and drop five before it ends. Pick a busy firefight, wait until enemies cluster, then focus and shoot. A fast weapon helps.
steps: Find a busy firefight with enemies clustered
Trigger Combat Focus
Drop 5 enemies before it ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — leave the airport by an unofficial route. This reads as a one-time scripted opportunity at VCIA: take it the first time the airport is open to you, because the description gives no repeat. Grab a plane or a fast vehicle and go.
steps: Go to VCIA when the airport is open to you
Leave by an unofficial route — a plane or a fast vehicle
Take it the first time; do not assume it repeats

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. The description's joke is the clue: this one involves the Rhino tanks, and it is tied to a story moment with tanks. Flagged missable: handle the Rhinos when they appear in the story rather than hoping they show up later.
steps: Watch for the Rhino tanks in the story
Deal with them when they appear
Do not assume they come back later

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses, no cameras catching you. Study the patrol pattern first, take the quiet route in, and leave before anyone notices. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — restart and try a different approach.
steps: Study the patrol pattern first
Take the quiet route in — no alarms, no witnesses
Leave before anyone notices

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — five separate vault jobs, each ending with a clean getaway. Vaults are the big jobs: plan the entry, grab the cash, and lose the heat. Each vault counts once; you need five.
steps: Plan the entry for a bank vault
Grab the cash and get away clean
Repeat at 5 different vaults

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes — find one, stop it, crack it and get away. Trucks are tougher than shops: bring something heavy for the doors and a fast car for the exit.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route
Stop it and crack it open
Escape in a fast car

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — every district, town and back road. Drive the highways end to end, then sweep the coasts and the interior. The PSN target counts 52 areas; the last few are the small towns most players skip.
steps: Drive the highways end to end
Sweep the coasts and the interior
52 areas total — the small towns are the last ones

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs operations — hit one per gang. The gangs are spread across the state, so this is a road trip: work the map gang by gang and check them off here.
steps: Find an illegal operation run by a gang
Rob it and get away
One per gang — 9 gangs total

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a story-beat moment — a quiet drink with a view. It is flagged missable because it belongs to a specific scene: take the cocktail when the scene offers it instead of walking past it.
steps: Watch for the Ocean Beach cocktail scene in the story
Take the cocktail when the scene offers it
Do not walk past it

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is a scripted moment — a showroom, a car, and a wall that needs a hole in it. It is flagged missable because the showroom moment happens once: when the scene gives you the car, drive through, do not park it.
steps: Watch for the vehicle showroom scene in the story
When the scene gives you the car, drive through the wall
Do not park it — the moment happens once

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The follow-through is the story beat at the alley — bowl the game when the scene offers it. Bowling itself is repeatable, but the story follow-through is not, so take it when it comes.
steps: Watch for the Kolt & Associates bowling alley scene
Bowl the game when the scene offers it
Take it when it comes — the follow-through does not repeat

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — a story beat with your partner. It is flagged missable because it belongs to a specific scene: play it when it comes up rather than assuming it repeats.
steps: Watch for the partnership scene in the story
Play it when it comes up
Do not assume it repeats

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks 500 of them. Choices happen all through the story and the open world: dialogue picks, approach picks, small decisions. They add up over a full playthrough, so just play naturally and make picks instead of skipping them. The 500 count is the long tail of the platinum, so do not farm it — let it come. Flagged missable because choices only happen while the story is running.
steps: Make picks instead of skipping them — dialogue and approach
Choices add up over a full playthrough
500 total — let it come, do not farm it

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. This one is about retrying: fail something, then get it on the second attempt. If a mission or activity goes wrong, do not reload — retry it and the trophy should pop on the second success.
steps: Fail a mission or activity once
Retry it instead of reloading
Succeed on the second attempt

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This reads as a one-time odd event in the world — the kind of thing that happens once and never again. Keep your eyes open while exploring, especially at night and in odd corners of the map, and do not skip strange scenes when they start.
steps: Explore at night and in odd corners of the map
Do not skip strange scenes when they start
The event happens once — be there for it

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. Drive by on a bike or in a slow car and swing a melee weapon as you pass. Bowling alleys are the obvious place to try it, but any pedestrian works — line up the pass and swing.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a bike or slow car
Line up a pass by a pedestrian
Swing the melee weapon as you drive by

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from the big jobs — pass them to your contacts to clean them. The PSN counter tracks $250,000 laundered, so keep funneling bills through contacts after every job instead of spending them dirty.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from the big jobs
Pass them to your contacts to launder
$250,000 laundered total

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Cars, clothes, weapons, food — everything counts. You will get most of the way there buying the cars and properties the game wants you to own; mop up the rest on ammo, clothes and snacks.
steps: Buy cars and properties as the game suggests
Spend on ammo, clothes and snacks to mop up
$100,000 spent total

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are for sale across Leonida — check the property markers, buy each one, and the trophy pops on the eighth. You need the money, so this pairs with the laundering and spending trophies.
steps: Check property markers for garages for sale
Buy each one as you can afford it
The trophy pops on the eighth garage

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find 10 different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one. Any vehicle counts — grab the nearest ten you have not registered yet.
steps: Find a vehicle you have not registered
Open the Scooter Bros app and register it
Repeat for 10 vehicles
